fusions.name: Gallop Down
fusions.desc: A charging blow on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Glancing Kick
fusions.desc: A glancing kick that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Nosebag
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 60% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fed and Watered
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
